name: Goethe A1 – Extended (additions)
description: Extra words from Goethe's Deutsch Online A1 course that are not in goethe-a1.json. The Extended library combines both files.

words.note: auf etwas achten = to pay attention to something
Was machen Sie beruflich? = What do you do for a living?
Sag mir Bescheid! = Let me know!
Also: Here you are. / You're welcome.

words.en: at the same time, while doing so

words.note: den Tisch decken = to set the table
Na dann eben ein Hemd. = Well, a shirt then.
In Hamburg gibt es einen Hafen.
Ich bin gespannt. = I can't wait to see.
etwas an die Wand hängen (hat gehängt) = to hang something on the wall
Das ist lange her. = That was a long time ago.
Indisch essen = to eat Indian food
sich für etwas interessieren = to be interested in something

words.en: to be, to read (e.g. an address)
words.note: Meine Adresse lautet ... = My address is ...

words.en: to be going on, to be the matter
words.note: Was ist los? = What's the matter?
Es geht los! = Here we go!
Gehen wir mal ins Kino? = Shall we go to the cinema sometime?

words.en: to go along, to go with

words.note: mitten in der Natur = in the middle of nature
Na, wie geht's? = So, how are you?
südlich von München = south of Munich
an etwas teilnehmen = to take part in something

words.en: on the way, out and about
to be busy, lots going on
words.note: Im Büro ist immer viel los.
Ich bin Lehrer von Beruf. = I am a teacher by profession.

words.en: to drop by, to come round
to be able to get away

words.note: The verb goes to the end: wenn Sie nicht kommen können

words.en: to come back, to come again

words.note: Die Pause ist zu Ende. = The break is over.
zu Mittag essen = to have lunch
